title: BitLocker protection status
whyItMatters: Whether each drive is protected determines how much data someone can read from the disk after handover, and whether a recovery key must be recorded.
notes: Read-only CIM query. ProtectionStatus 1 means protected, 0 means off. Recovery keys are not retrieved; only the two named properties are requested.

cleanup.exportFirst: Record the BitLocker recovery key for every protected drive, and keep that record off this PC, before the machine changes hands.
steps: Note which drives the plan shows as protected.
Find the recovery key in your Microsoft account or your organisation's directory and store it somewhere else.
Leave protection on until the PC is reset, because a reset needs the key.
cleanup.risk: Turning protection off leaves the drive readable to anyone who gets the disk. Losing the recovery key locks you out of an encrypted drive for good.
